definitions.explanation: A country that is experiencing rapid economic growth and industrialization but has not yet reached the level of developed nations.

examples.japanese: {新興国|しんこうこく}の{経済|けいざい}{成長|せいちょう}が{注目|ちゅうもく}されている。
examples.english: The economic growth of emerging nations is attracting attention.

examples.japanese: {多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{新興国|しんこうこく}に{進出|しんしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Many companies are expanding into emerging nations.

examples.japanese: {新興国|しんこうこく}の{急速|きゅうそく}な{発展|はってん}は{世界|せかい}{経済|けいざい}の{構造|こうぞう}を{大|おお}きく{変|か}えつつある。
examples.english: The rapid development of emerging nations is significantly changing the structure of the world economy.

notes:
A compound of {新興|しんこう} (newly risen, emerging) and {国|こく} (country). This is the standard Japanese term for what English calls "emerging markets" or "emerging economies," and it appears frequently in economic news and international affairs discussions.

USAGE:
- Often used as a の-modifier: {新興国|しんこうこく}の{市場|しじょう} (emerging market)
- Frequently contrasted with {先進国|せんしんこく} (developed countries)
- Common in news, economics, and business contexts

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新興国|しんこうこく}{市場|しじょう}: emerging market
- {新興国|しんこうこく}{経済|けいざい}: emerging economy
- {新興国|しんこうこく}への{投資|とうし}: investment in emerging countries
- {新興国|しんこうこく}の{台頭|たいとう}: rise of emerging nations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {先進国|せんしんこく}: developed country, advanced nation — the opposite; economically mature countries
- {途上国|とじょうこく}: developing country — broader; includes countries at various stages of development, not necessarily growing rapidly
- {新興|しんこう}: emerging, newly risen — the adjective/prefix alone, applicable to companies, religions, etc.
